_comment: Quebec. The federal return only: no provincial tax section, and a refundable abatement instead. The inverse of every other jurisdiction, which is why it is worth having.

checks.message: This covers only the federal part of a Quebec return.
checks.help: Quebec assesses its own income tax on form TP1, filed separately with Revenu Quebec. Freshet does not prepare TP1, so a Quebec resident using this has only half of what they owe.

lines.label: Refundable Quebec abatement
lines.note: Line 44000. A Quebec resident pays no provincial tax on the federal return, and receives this abatement of basic federal tax instead, because Quebec collects its own income tax.

lines.label: Quebec tax on the federal return
lines.note: Nil by design, not by omission. Quebec income tax is assessed on form TP1 and filed with Revenu Quebec, which Freshet does not do. The check below says so.
